text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer organized paragraphs with intro body conclusion","quality":"text organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into connected sections that develop the response in a sustained way."},{"evidence":"uses transitions like \"Although,\" \"Even though,\" and \"In conclusion\"","quality":"cohesive linking","description":"The essay more consistently connects ideas with discourse markers and signposting."},{"evidence":"develops a claim with repeated explanation about choice and character","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay elaborates its main points more fully instead of relying on brief statements and examples."},{"evidence":"quotations and references to \"Lying is not better than silence\" and Joker/Batman","quality":"supporting detail","description":"The essay uses more specific examples and references to support its argument."},{"evidence":"mostly correct sentence boundaries and capitalization of a formal essay","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows stronger control of sentence structure and written academic formatting."},{"evidence":"fewer misspellings than \"choses,\" \"benifict,\" \"skiping,\" and \"trable\" in A","quality":"spelling control","description":"The essay has comparatively better command of conventional spelling."},{"evidence":"more precise vocabulary such as \"trustworthy,\" \"consequences,\" and \"traits\"","quality":"word choice","description":"The essay uses more varied and apt vocabulary to express abstract ideas."}]}
